item.text: {"claim_id":"C022","obligation_id":"C022-B-1","contract":"OPERATION_LICENSE","subject":"The proposed continuity signal is an internally consistent history linking the order, received product, relevant service encounters, and examined evidence.","verdict":"SATISFIED","unresolved_conditions":[],"rationale":"The proposed inspection criterion faithfully transfers the source mechanism: examine documentary continuity linking a particular item through handling events.
